notes.title: Failure Review allows you to review multiple problems.
notes.content:
"Failure Review", a feature for reviewing failed problems, is now available for multiple problems.
You can use Failure Review to review all failed questions in Endless mode or in the mission "Brain Shock".

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39601067/631c9459a6293463b20179a06dfe57ab230a9882.jpg[/img]

If you absorb all difficult problems in Standard or Expert mode, you may be able to improve your groundwork efficiently!

In addition, minor bug in the game over effects has been fixed.

notes.title: You can review failure problem now!
notes.content:
"I died because I melted all my time on a single puzzle... I'm bewildered because I don't know the right answer..."
Yes, in this game everyone dies like that...

We've added a new feature called "Failure Review" that lets you review problems you didn't solve!
If you die once, you can solve it again! The more you die, the more you grow! And then you can break through!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39601067/f5e6c4c7f72ad4db86347802a138800b5976cf36.png[/img]

Press Space key after dead to start "Failure Review".
